# Psalm 115 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Not to us, LORD — not to us, but to your name give the glory! Because of your faithful love and your reliability!

**2** Why should the nations ask, 'So where's their God?'

**3** Our God is in heaven — he does whatever he wants!

**4** Their idols are just silver and gold — things made by human hands.

**5** They have mouths but can't speak. They have eyes but can't see.

**6** They have ears but can't hear. They have noses but can't smell.

**7** They have hands but can't feel. They have feet but can't walk. They can't even make a sound.

**8** The people who make them will end up just like them — and so will everyone who trusts in them.

**9** Israel, trust in the LORD! He is your helper and your shield.

**10** House of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is your helper and your shield.

**11** All who honor the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is your helper and your shield.

**12** The LORD remembers us and will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.

**13** He will bless everyone who honors the LORD — from the least to the greatest.

**14** May the LORD multiply your blessings — yours and your children's!

**15** May you be blessed by the LORD, the maker of heaven and earth!

**16** The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but he gave the earth to the human race.

**17** The dead can't praise the LORD — no one in the grave can.

**18** But we will praise the LORD from now until forever! Hallelujah!

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **115:4-8**: The most devastating take-down of idolatry in the Bible: they have mouths but can't talk, eyes but can't see... and here's the kicker — the people who make them become just as lifeless. You become what you worship.

- **115:16**: A remarkable verse: God keeps heaven for himself but hands the earth over to humanity. It's both a gift and a responsibility — God entrusts the world to us.

— PNEUMA
